headline: onsemi Q3 Results Show AI Data Center Surge Amid Auto Softening
summary: onsemi released its Q3 2026 slides, highlighting strong growth in AI data center demand while automotive sector demand softened.
why: Semiconductor manufacturers serving multiple end-markets provide critical data points on cyclical demand shifts between automotive chips and high-performance computing.

impacts.name: onsemi
impacts.why: Results reflected opposing trends of surging AI demand and softening automotive revenue.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Diverging segmental performance creates mixed expectations for chipmakers exposed to both automotive and AI infrastructure.
